body: We currently only support reading the exact version, as structures change, resulting in reading different sizes for the header, etc. It often results in errors that the size is wrong, but that is unsafe. If it turns out the size hasn't change for a particular segment, but the binary format has, it will break.
Always read the default values in to local_size
If the local size specifies a `local_size_<dim>_id = <id>`, capture the `<id>`

* `compute_local_size` is guaranteed to contain sane default value from the shader
* `compute_local_spec_id` is available to all backends, so that those which need to inspect the spec constant values at pipeline creation
